evals.name: convert-docx-positive
evals.prompt: I have a report.docx I can't read — extract its contents as Markdown.
evals.expected_output: Triggers the skill and runs the pinned anydoc CLI on the file, emitting GitHub-Flavored Markdown.
expectations: Invokes anydoc via npx -y @firecrawl/anydoc@0.2.4, not an unversioned or @latest spec
Passes the document path as the CLI argument
Surfaces the converted Markdown (stdout or -o file) without prompting the user

evals.name: scanned-pdf-exit-3
evals.prompt: anydoc just failed on my scanned.pdf saying pages need OCR. What now?
evals.expected_output: Explains exit 3 and that rerunning with --ocr hosted uploads the file to Firecrawl's hosted Parse API, optionally with FIRECRAWL_API_KEY for higher limits.
expectations: Identifies exit code 3 as 'pages of a PDF need OCR'
States plainly that --ocr hosted sends the file to Firecrawl's hosted API
Mentions --api-key or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY for higher limits

evals.name: negative-readable-markdown
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger the skill — notes.md is plain Markdown the agent can read directly.
expectations: Does not invoke the anydoc CLI

evals.name: negative-create-document
evals.prompt: Draft a new Word document with the project charter.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger the skill — it converts documents to Markdown, it does not create or edit documents.
expectations: Does not invoke the anydoc CLI
